new_claim.statement: For three disjoint original-coordinate aggregate banks with quadratic core T=2aUV+hV^2+b(Z+qV)^2, if the compressed 3x3 bank matrix has all three eigenvalue magnitudes at least s>0, then ||p_T||_infinity<=8/s for arbitrary independent cap-one coordinate laws. Independent direct-sum quadratic remainders preserve the bound.

key_identity: For M=[[0,x,0],[x,z,w],[0,w,y]], M^{-1}_{12}=1/x and M^{-1}_{33}=1/y; hence sigma_min(M)>=s implies |xy|>=s^2. The aggregate hyperbolic-square parameter eta is exactly |xy|.
